checks.note: Audit records carry agentTypeId, but the only manifest is the single current release/manifest.json. Nothing stores manifests keyed by id, so ids from earlier releases resolve to nothing.

The main loop records context size on model.decision. The classifier model call (classifier.ts:45, which routes messages) is a model decision too, and its audit record has no context field or span attributes.
There is no sub-agent spawn. The only peer call sends structured data, not a parent prompt, so no prompt needs storing.
The audit bucket has 7-year object lock. Retention for manifests and traces, and role-based access to sensitive artifacts, are not configured in this repo.
